lessons.title: Phone Calls, Taking Messages and Excuses
lessons.description: Making appointments, phone conversations and taking notes

questions.rule:
• Answering the phone: 'Hello, this is Mark speaking.' / 'How may I help you?'
• Asking for someone: 'Could you put me through to Mr. Clark?' / 'Is Sarah in?'
• Connecting: 'Hold on a second, please. I'll put you through.' / 'Hang on a minute.'
• Unavailable (Not at desk / busy): 'I'm afraid he is not available at the moment. He is busy.' / 'The line is engaged.'
• Leaving / Taking a message: 'Would you like to leave a message?' / 'Could you tell him to call me back?'
• Bad line: 'It's a bad line. Could you speak louder, please?'
questions.examTip: LGS questions often test 'Hold on / Hang on' (beklemek) and 'Put through' (telefona bağlamak). Don't confuse 'Hold on' with 'Hang up' (telefonu kapatmak)!

questions.prompt:
Secretary: 'Hello, Green Hospital. How may I help you?'
David: 'Hello, may I speak to Dr. Roberts, please?'
Secretary: '_____ I'll put you through.' Which expression completes the dialogue?
questions.explanation: 'Hold on a minute, please. I'll put you through' (Lütfen bir dakika hatta bekleyin, bağlıyorum) doğru kalıptır.

questions.prompt:
Tom: 'Can I speak to Jack?'
Sam: 'I'm afraid he is not at home right now. _____?'
Tom: 'Yes, please tell him to call Tom about our project.'
options: Would you like to leave a message?
questions.explanation: Jack evde olmadığı için 'Mesaj bırakmak ister misiniz?' (Would you like to leave a message?) sorulmalıdır.

questions.prompt: 'Hang up the phone' means to end a telephone conversation by putting down the receiver.
"I can't hear you well because it's a bad line. Could you speak _____?"
questions.explanation: Hat kötü olduğunda sesin duyulması için 'Could you speak louder?' (Daha yüksek sesle konuşabilir misiniz?) denir.

questions.prompt: When the person you want to talk to is on another call, the secretary says: 'The line is _____.'
questions.explanation: Telefon hattı meşgulse 'The line is busy / engaged' denir.

questions.prompt: Match the phone phrases with their meanings:

matchingPairs.right: Connect someone on the phone (Telefona bağlamak)

questions.prompt: Which of the following is NOT a way of communication?
questions.explanation: Listening to music is an entertainment activity, not an active method of communicating with another person.

lessons.title: 🏆 Unit Trophy Exam: On The Phone LGS Exam
lessons.description: LGS MEB telephone dialogue and message comprehension exam

questions.prompt: According to research, teenagers mostly use their smartphones for _____. Which option best completes a typical LGS survey question?
questions.explanation: Gençler akıllı telefonları en çok sosyal medya ve mesajlaşma için kullanır.

questions.prompt: "Hi, this is Linda. I'm calling to inform you that our meeting is postponed to Friday." Why did Linda call?
options: To change the date of the meeting
questions.explanation: 'Postpone' ertelemek demektir; toplantının Cuma gününe ertelendiğini bildirmek için aramıştır.

questions.prompt: Alexander Graham Bell _____ the telephone in 1876.
questions.explanation: Telefon insan yapımı bir buluş olduğu için 'invented' (icat etti) kullanılır.

questions.prompt:
Customer Service: 'Star Airlines, how can I help you?'
Passenger: 'I'd like to make a reservation for a flight to London.' What is the passenger's purpose?
questions.explanation: Yolcunun amacı uçak bileti rezervasyonu yapmaktır (booking a ticket).

questions.prompt: 'Keep in touch' means to maintain regular communication with someone.
questions.explanation: True! 'Keep in touch' irtibatta kalmak, iletişimi koparmamak demektir.

questions.prompt: If you don't know who is calling, which question should you ask politely?
options: May I ask who is calling?
questions.explanation: 'May I ask who is calling?' (Kimin aradığını öğrenebilir miyim?) en kibar telefon ifadesidir.

questions.prompt: Match the abbreviations with their meanings:
Which sentence expresses a complaint on the phone?
options: The product I bought yesterday is broken and not working properly.
I'd like to invite you to dinner.
Could you tell him I called?
questions.explanation: Bozuk ürün bildirimi müşteri hizmetlerine yapılan bir şikayettir (complaint).
